title: Amikacin (historical/salvage)
dek: A 16S-binding aminoglycoside that left preferred regimens because ears and kidneys lost to all-oral Group A. rrs 1401 still predicts it. Pregnancy: do not.
story: Amikacin was a Group C injectable backbone of 20th-century MDR therapy. WHO retired injectables from preferred short regimens once BDQ/LZD/Pa/FQ all-oral constructs won. It remains salvage when Group A is exhausted and the genome/MIC say the 16S site is intact.

rrs 1401 a>g (numbering wars with E. coli 1408) is high-level AMK/KAN resistance. eis promoter-up is KAN-weighted; confirm AMK with MIC. Daily IM/IV, therapeutic drug monitoring if you have it, audiometry if you are ethical.
Pregnancy: fetal ototoxicity. Children: last-resort only. Do not add AMK to BPaLM “for strength.”
deep: KAN is essentially a worse AMK with more eis problems. CAP needs tlyA methylation. See tb-eis-rrs.
Ototoxicity can be delayed and permanent. That sentence retired a drug class.
If you use it, it is a designed salvage regimen, not a nostalgia tour.

visual.caption: Injectables sit behind a closed preferred-regimen gate. Open it only when Group A is gone and rrs/MIC allow. Pregnancy keeps the gate shut.

example.title: rrs 1401, “just a bit of AMK”
example.setup: XDR 2021, someone wants amikacin three times a week because the patient is tired of pills. WGS rrs 1401 a>g.

steps.title: Genetically dead
steps.body: 1401 is the canonical high-level allele. This is ototoxicity without benefit.

steps.title: Find another salvage axis
steps.body: Carbapenem+clavulanate, surgery, trials — not a 16S that is already mutant.

steps.title: Document the no
steps.body: So the next rotation does not retry KAN.

example.takeaway: AMK is historical/salvage, gated by rrs and by ears.
